working_definition: Dorsal (Wnt10+) subpopulation of Tm9 transmedullary neurons, named by the authors (Özel et al. 2021); pharate adult and adult stages.
searches_performed: transmedullary neuron Tm9d (exact synonym, FBbt fbbt/releases/2026-10-01)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron Tm9 that targets the dorsal half of the lobula. It is distinguished from other Tm9 neurons by its expression of Wnt10 (Kurmangaliyev et al., 2020).

justification: FBbt records 'transmedullary neuron Tm9d' as an EXACT synonym of Tm9a, sourced from this paper (FlyBase:FBrf0247762, Özel et al. 2021), so FBbt curators have already equated the authors' Tm9d with Tm9a (dorsal, Wnt10+). Same term as the immature mapping's mature form.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary narrow field neuron that has most of its dendritic arborization in medulla layers M2 and M3, with some extensions into M1, M4 and M5 (Gao et al., 2008; Ting et al., 2014), and presynapses in M3 (Gao et al., 2008). Its axon follows the posterior edge of its cognate medulla column (Ting et al., 2014), then crosses in the second optic chiasma and terminates in lobula layer 1 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Ting et al., 2014), where it outputs to T5 neurons (Shinomiya et al., 2014). It is a cholinergic neuron (Gao et al., 2008; Shinomiya et al., 2014). It expresses the transcription factor sim (Ozel et al., 2021). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent type; FBbt has the dorsal subtype term (Tm9a) with Tm9d as an exact synonym.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00058233 'transmedullary neuron Tm9a' (exact match; Tm9d is its exact synonym from this paper).
